summary: Iteration 17: Verified the new 'Manual difficulty picker in Adjust crop tab' feature. Backend 5/5 pytest pass (test_iter17.py): QP tab PUT difficulty=Hard renames QP file + syncs memo filename to _Hard.png; Memo tab PUT difficulty updates matching QP question and renames both; memo main label propagates to all QP sub-children (hits = startswith norm+'.' when no exact leaf match); crafted memo label 99.99 that has no QP match -> 400 'No Q99.99 in the question paper to rate'; LEVELS is case-sensitive so 'beginner' as the raw value -> 400. Frontend Playwright test on cloned set 464fc59b-8580-40e3-89fc-249ed0ee9fa5: Adjust crop tab exposes [data-testid=crop-difficulty] with crop-difficulty-easy/-medium/-hard buttons, current level highlighted via bg-white/10, tap Hard => toast 'Difficulty set to Hard', stays on Adjust tab, lightbox-download-button filename updates to _Hard.png, closing dialog shows updated question-difficulty-{order} badge on card. Memo tab -> linked-memo-{qid}-adjust shows linked-memo-{qid}-difficulty picker with 3 buttons; tap Easy => toast 'Difficulty set to Easy/Beginner', stays on adjust mode, linked filename span updates to MEMO_Q1.1_Easy.png. No regressions on question-difficulty-select dropdown.
critical_code_review_comments: DifficultyPicker is correctly idempotent: clicking the already-selected level is a no-op (k !== value guard), avoiding redundant PUT.
LinkedEditor passes stay=true to act() so the picker remains on the Adjust tab after save, matching the user choice 'saves instantly on tap' without closing the editor.
QuestionDialog.Adjust uses the same act() wrapper (stay implicit by not calling setTab after onPick), so it also stays on the Adjust crop tab after rating is saved - verified in Playwright.

routes.set_qp_difficulty's fallback (startswith norm+'.') correctly propagates a memo main-label rating to all QP sub-children (e.g. memo '4' -> QP '4.1' and '4.2'). renumber then regenerates filenames.

routes.update_question accepts difficulty='' to clear (q.difficulty = body.difficulty or None) and strips DIFF_FLAG; a non-empty bogus value returns 400 'Difficulty must be Easy, Medium or Hard'. 'beginner' lowercase is treated as bogus here (LEVELS is strict); frontend DIFFICULTY labels map 'Easy' -> 'Easy/Beginner' which is correct separation of label vs canonical value.

DifficultyPicker uses testIds `${testId}-${k.toLowerCase()}` so main-tab buttons are crop-difficulty-easy/-medium/-hard and linked-memo-{qid}-difficulty-easy/-medium/-hard - exactly matching the test contract.
Rating via memo correctly surfaces 'No Qx in the question paper to rate' to the toast (toast.error consumes response.data.detail). Spec compliant.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (QP picker, linked memo picker, toast, filename, badge, stay-on-adjust all verified)

Frontend contract: crop-difficulty picker on QP Adjust tab, linked-{kind}-{qid}-difficulty picker inside LinkedEditor Adjust mode, both toasts message 'Difficulty set to {Easy/Beginner|Medium|Hard}'. Stay-on-tab behavior is driven by the `stay` arg of QuestionDialog.act / LinkedEditor.act.
